subject: Re: Request — Quarterly invoicing + Net-90 for pilot (Olive Healthcare)
messages:
From: Susan Park <susan.park@olivehealthcare.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: Quarterly invoicing + Net-90 for pilot

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the throughput and the prefix caching savings. We have an internal constraint: our fiscal team only approves vendor invoices on a quarterly cadence for pilots and any new vendor requires a 90-day payment window.

Can Redwood accommodate a 90-day payment term and quarterly invoicing for our 3-month pilot? We can sign the order form today if we get an exec-level exception confirmed (procurement requires an email from your finance/ legal authorizing the cadence).

I've attached a short pilot scope (OLIVE-PILOT-MAP.pdf) and included procurement on cc. Please let me know the exact items you need to finalize.

Thanks,
Susan Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Olive Healthcare

--- Attachment: OLIVE-PILOT-MAP.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Susan Park <susan.park@olivehealthcare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Quarterly invoicing + Net-90 for pilot

Hi Susan —

Appreciate the clarity and the fast turnaround. Short answer: Redwood can consider a conditional quarterly invoicing + Net-90 for a limited pilot, subject to executive approval and a few guardrails from Finance.

Proposed conditions we need to include in the order form and SOW:
- Pilot limited to 3 months and a $50k not-to-exceed commitment.
- Upfront authorization: Olive provides a signed SOW and executes the order form with an acknowledgement of the payment cadence.
- Redwood retains the right to convert to monthly invoicing if usage exceeds thresholds; details in SOW appendix.

Marissa (account lead) — can you confirm the commercial tradeoffs we proposed (3% transaction fee vs. standard monthly billing) and whether Legal already has a redline?
Rishi (Finance) — please confirm if Finance can support a conditional exception and what documentation you need for exec review.

If you can confirm acceptance of the guardrails, we'll route to Exec for sign-off today.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
--- Attachment: OLIVE-PILOT-MAP.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-04T14:25:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Quarterly invoicing + Net-90 for pilot

Eve / Marissa —

Finance is OK with a short-term, conditional Net-90 + quarterly invoice cadence for this pilot under the following items:
1) Deal cap at $50k for the pilot period and a refund/offset clause if usage is materially higher and not pre-authorized.
2) Pre-approved payment schedule sheet (we need Procurement to fill in expected remit dates).
3) A small fee to offset longer DSO: 2.5% processing uplift (we can waive if Olive enrolls in annual prepay on conversion).
4) Signed redline of our payment clause in custom-terms-redline.docx (attached) and a named finance approver on the PO.

I've attached a quick scorecard with expected DSO impact and recommended uplift. If Exec approves, I can sign off and instruct Billing to create a quarterly invoice schedule.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Priyom —

Forwarding the thread and attachments. Olive Healthcare (prospect, pilot) requires a temporary quarterly invoicing cadence and Net-90 for a 3-month pilot. Finance has validated with conditions (deal cap $50k, 2.5% uplift, signed redline).

Key ask: Exec sign-off on a one-time exception for this pilot so Sales can finalize the order form today. If approved, we'll include the conditions Rishi noted in the SOW appendix and instruct Billing to schedule quarterly invoices.

Quick summary of tradeoffs:
- Upside: close pilot this quarter; strong chance to convert to a multi-year contract given Olive's footprint in two regions.
- Downside: ~30-day incremental DSO impact, mitigated by 2.5% uplift and fixed cap.

Please reply with: APPROVE or REJECT and any additional required conditions.

Thanks for a fast turnaround — Susan is waiting on our confirmation to sign.

Best,
Evelyn
